name: Ouma Shuu
source:
The protagonist of the anime series in his childhood. He was living in Oshima at the time, but has gone to Roppongi with his mother-in-law he calls by her name, [url=/c13847]Haruka[/url], in order to spend Christmas with his family.

[Translated from [url=http://www.nitroplus.co.jp/game/lost_x/character/other/]official site[/url].]
